nodes.description: Initializer guarded by Initializable.initializer modifier; sets owner, EMM, abacus, EDM and Init pointers.
Reassigns the contract owner; only checks msg.sender == owner without two-step transfer.
Owner-only refresh of external contract pointers from EcoceliumInit.
Payable deposit entrypoint; pulls real tokens, pushes free storage, mints and locks wrapped tokens.
Internal deposit helper dispatching to EcoMoneyManager.DepositManager and emitting swap.
Payable combined deposit plus order creation.
Locks an existing deposit and creates an order; mints ECO earnings.
Borrow path; checks withdrawal eligibility then creates an order as borrower.
External wrapper for EcoceliumDataManager.payDue with caller-supplied order id.
Payable borrow clearing; pops borrow storage and forwards funds to DepositManager.
Withdraws borrowed funds to the caller after eligibility check and freePusher bookkeeping.
Wrapped-to-wrapped swap priced from oracle data with unchecked multiplication chain.
Cancels an open order after reading the creator from the data manager.
Payable withdraw entrypoint with OR-chain branching over balances, ECO earnings and locked funds.
Internal withdraw helper releasing/burning wrapped tokens and paying out the net amount.
Buying-power based eligibility check used by Borrow and Withdraw.
Friendly-address gated push of free deposit/borrow storage records with USD valuation.
Pops free storage entries while amount remains, computes ECO dues and pays owner fee vault.
Order matching engine loop over the sorted order pool; pushes and matches orders.
Internal order insertion writing openOrderMap and registering the order in the user arrays.
Matches two orders, stamps timestamps, schedules oracle callbacks and mints wrapped tokens.
Inserts/removes orders in the per-token pool and recomputes poolindex.
Expiry handler releasing wrapped tokens and mutating user accounting before deleting order state.
Burns ECO dues from a caller-supplied address and updates the dues counter.
Scheduled monthly due check that locks users, mints ECO to the supplier and reschedules.
Builds calldata and pays the Abacus oracle to call orderExpired later.
Builds calldata and pays the Abacus oracle to call dueCheck later.
Cancels an open order, releases wrapped tokens and removes it from the pool.
Converts a token amount to USD using the oracle price and wrapped token decimals.
Computes the monthly due with an unchecked chained multiplication of amount, yield, duration and price.
Reads the token price from the Abacus oracle response array.
Time-weighted ECO reward calculation using block timestamp and slab rates.
Loops deposits and borrows to accumulate net ECO earnings less withdrawals.
Derives buying power from total deposit, CDS percent and total borrowed.
Whitelists an address; the owner check is written as a tuple expression instead of require.
Friendly-address only fee update for swap, trade and reward fees.
Owner-only ownership transfer for the init/registry contract.
Transfers ETH via address.transfer or approves and pulls ERC20 out to the user.
Payable deposit intake pulling ERC20 via transferFrom from a caller-supplied user address.
Friendly-address only wrapped token swap: release, burn, mint and lock.
Transfers wrapped ECO from the manager to a user and books the withdrawal.
Owner-only deployment of a new wERC20 wrapped token with arbitrary metadata.
MINTER_ROLE gated mint of wrapped tokens.
MINTER_ROLE gated burn of tokens from an arbitrary address.
ETMOWNER_ROLE gated rotation of admin, minter and pauser roles.
Low-level value transfer to an arbitrary payable address with full gas forwarding.
Arbitrary low-level call to a target contract using caller-supplied calldata.
Core balance mutation enforcing the available-amount rule against locked balances.
Checked addition library helper.
Checked subtraction library helper.
Checked multiplication library helper.
Single owner address controlling upgrade pointers and fees.
Mapping of user address to deposits, borrows, orders and USD accounting.
Per-token sorted array of open order ids.
Matched order records with supplier, borrower, expiry and dues.
Pending order records keyed by order id.
Lifecycle status of each order id.
Cached split index between borrow and creator sides of the pool.
Whitelist mapping gating nearly all privileged cross-contract calls.
Accumulated protocol fees per token symbol.
Per-user lock flag used to block withdrawals until dues are paid.
Registrar flag granting special buy power and due exemptions.
Wrapped token configuration keyed by symbol including oracle fetch id.
Per-address locked wrapped token amount excluded from availability.
Token balance ledger mutated by transfers, mints and burns.
Total wrapped token supply.
Accumulated ECO earnings already redeemed per user.
External caller of the Ecocelium entrypoints.
Block timestamp (now) used for interest, expiry and due timing.
Caller of EcoceliumDataManager functions; gated only by the friendly address whitelist.
Caller of the registry/admin contract functions.
Caller of EcoMoneyManager asset movement functions.
Caller of wERC20 mint/burn/role functions.
address.transfer of native ETH to a user-controlled address.
Full-gas low-level call{value} transferring ETH to an arbitrary recipient.
Arbitrary calldata low-level call to a caller supplied target.
Payable external call into the Abacus oracle that schedules a future callback into this contract.
Chained multiplication of amount, yield, duration and price with precision loss risk.
Timestamp-scaled reward arithmetic with divide-before-multiply precision loss.
delete on myOrders using an order id as array index, corrupting user order bookkeeping.
External ERC20 transferFrom executed on behalf of a caller-supplied user address.
Privileged wrapped token mint/burn and lock manipulation executed through EMM.
Amount parameter of freePopper controlling how much storage is popped.

Accumulated ECO earnings returned to the caller.

Balance minus locked deposits and borrows used in the OR-chain branching.
Owner address assigned during initialization.
Payable recipient of the ETH/ERC20 transfer.

Month index compared against the paid dues counter.

Computed ECO reward value returned by the earning calculation.

edges.reason: freePopper._amount drives the pop loop bound and the deposit/borrow accounting.
newOrder._status chooses creator or borrower branch and pool index side.
matchOrder._orderId selects the order record being matched and mutated.
orderExpired._orderId indexes the matched order that is released and deleted.
payDue burns ECO dues from the caller supplied msgSender parameter.
Withdraw._amount flows into the balance and eligibility comparisons.
Deposit._amount is used for the token pull, mint and lock.
token1amount feeds the swap pricing arithmetic.
dues accumulator is returned to the caller and forwarded to the fee vault.
amountLeft controls the storage pop loop termination.
availableBalance decides which withdraw branch is taken.
initialize._owner is written into the owner state variable.
WithdrawManager.userAddress is the destination of the value/token transfer.
temp buffer receives the rebuilt order pool array.
month is compared to the paid dues counter in the due check.
symbol is registered into the wTokens mapping for the new token.
reward is the value returned by calculateECOEarning.
msg.sender becomes _msgSender and receives minted and locked wrapped tokens.
msg.sender is compared to userAddress before creating the order.
msg.sender drives the lock check and all withdraw branch selection.
msg.sender must equal the order creator before cancellation.
The owner check relies solely on msg.sender equality.
msg.sender must equal the userAddress borrowing funds.
msg.sender is used as the swap counterparty in token movement.
msg.sender is the payable recipient inside the internal withdraw.
freePusher trusts the friendly address whitelist for msg.sender.
freePopper trusts the friendly address whitelist for msg.sender.
newOrder is reachable by any whitelisted caller with arbitrary userAddress.
orderExpired is callable by any whitelisted address for any expired order id.
payDue has no access check and accepts an arbitrary msgSender address.
cancelOrder relies only on the friendly address whitelist.
now is stamped into freeStorage records that drive reward calculation.
now sets the match time and expiryDate of the matched order.
Expiry is validated against block.timestamp.
Due accrual timing depends on block.timestamp comparisons.
Reward amount scales with now minus the recorded deposit time.
setFriendlyAddress intends to restrict msg.sender to owner but uses a non-reverting expression.
Fee updates are gated on the friendly address whitelist for msg.sender.
changeOwner compares msg.sender with the stored owner.
WithdrawManager only checks the friendly address whitelist of msg.sender.
DepositManager only checks the friendly address whitelist of msg.sender.
w2wswap only checks the friendly address whitelist of msg.sender.
redeemEcoEarning only checks the friendly address whitelist of msg.sender.
mint requires the MINTER_ROLE for msg.sender.
burnFrom requires the MINTER_ROLE for msg.sender.
orderMonthlyDue chains multiplications of amount, yield, duration and oracle price.
calculateECOEarning divides by 1e8 before multiplying, losing precision.
cancelOrder deletes array slots indexed by the order id rather than by position.
Native ETH transfer to a user happens before user accounting is finalized.
Value transfer to an arbitrary address can re-enter and observe stale balances.
Arbitrary low-level call can re-enter balance mutation paths.
External transferFrom on a real token can re-enter before state updates.
Mint/burn and lock/release sequences mutate lockedAmount across external calls.
Deposit delegates token intake to the internal _deposit helper.
Deposit records the free storage entry through the data manager.
depositAndOrder performs the deposit first.
depositAndOrder then submits an order to the matching engine.
createOrder pops free deposit storage to release it for the order.
createOrder registers the new order in the matching engine.
borrowOrder creates a borrower side order.
payDueOrder forwards to the data manager due payment.
clearBorrow pops borrow storage to settle the position.
Borrow records the borrowed amount in free storage.
SwapWrapToWrap prices token1 through the data manager USD value helper.
SwapWrapToWrap executes the wrapped token swap in the money manager.
SwapWrapToWrap pops the input token storage and accrues dues.
SwapWrapToWrap pushes the output token into free storage.
Ecocelium.cancelOrder delegates to the data manager cancellation.
Withdraw delegates the actual payout to _withdraw.
Withdraw pops the corresponding free storage before payout.
Withdraw validates eligibility through isWithdrawEligible.
Withdraw routes payouts through the money manager withdraw path.
Withdraw may redeem accumulated ECO earnings to cover the shortfall.
_withdraw releases and pays out through the money manager.
_withdraw pops the deposit storage for the withdrawn token.
_withdraw pushes the withdrawn funds back through the deposit manager.
newOrder inserts a residual order via pushOrder.
newOrder matches the crossing order against the pool head.
pushOrder re-sorts the pool after insertion.
matchOrder schedules the oracle expiry callback.
matchOrder schedules the recurring due check callback.
matchOrder stores the USD value of the matched amount.
matchOrder relies on the due calculation for later payments.
orderExpired releases wrapped tokens through the money manager.
User accounting is decremented after the external token release call.
payDue computes the amount owed with orderMonthlyDue.
dueCheck recomputes the monthly due before minting rewards.
dueCheck reschedules itself while dues remain.
scheduleExpiry pays the oracle to invoke the expiry callback.
scheduleCheck pays the oracle to invoke the due check callback.
cancelOrder releases wrapped tokens for creator orders.
cancelOrder removes the order from the sorted pool.
USDValue reads the oracle price through fetchTokenPrice.
orderMonthlyDue converts the matched amount to USD.
orderMonthlyDue fetches the ECO token price from the oracle.
calculateECOEarning fetches the ECO price for reward conversion.
getECOEarnings aggregates per-record earnings.
freePusher values the pushed amount in USD.
freePopper accrues ECO dues while popping records.
freePopper converts popped amounts to USD.
changeOwner writes the owner state variable.
setFriendlyAddress writes the whitelist without an effective owner guard.
changeOwner rewrites the registry owner.
createWrapToken is restricted to the money manager owner.
WithdrawManager performs the native ETH transfer.
sendValue reaches the low-level call transferring ETH.
_functionCallWithValue performs the arbitrary low-level call.
DepositManager executes the external token transferFrom.
mint is a privileged wrapped token issuance operation.
burnFrom is a privileged wrapped token destruction operation.
The oracle schedules a future call into orderExpired, an externally triggered re-entry point.
The oracle schedules a future call into dueCheck with caller supplied parameters.
The payable caller address is passed as the recipient of the internal withdraw.

normalization_plan.reason: freePopper._amount is only meaningful inside EcoceliumDataManager.freePopper and should be folded into it.
newOrder._status only selects the branch inside newOrder.
matchOrder._orderId is the lookup key used exclusively by matchOrder.
orderExpired._orderId indexes the order record handled by orderExpired.
payDue.msgSender is only used to burn dues inside payDue.
Withdraw._amount is consumed only by the withdraw branch logic.
Deposit._amount is consumed only by the deposit flow.
token1amount is only used by the swap price arithmetic.
the dues accumulator lives entirely within freePopper.
amountLeft is a loop counter local to freePopper.
availableBalance is a temporary local of the withdraw branching.
initialize._owner is immediately stored into owner.
WithdrawManager.userAddress is the transfer destination used only there.
the temp array local is only a scratch buffer for poolSorter.
dueCheck.month is only compared inside the due check.
the symbol parameter is registered only inside createWrapToken.
the reward local is the return value of calculateECOEarning.
